corrective_action: Develop standardized Green ICT KPIs for all major operators
evidence_basis: Inconsistent indicators, baselines and reporting limit cross-operator comparison
rule: If important Green ICT indicators are reported inconsistently across operators, require standardized sector-level KPIs

corrective_action: Require standardized operator-level disclosure of GHG emissions and e-waste information
evidence_basis: Operator-level GHG or telecom-specific e-waste quantities are not sufficiently disclosed
rule: If core GHG or e-waste information is missing or not comparable, require standardized disclosure

corrective_action: Strengthen network energy-efficiency measures and improve energy-demand management
evidence_basis: Energy demand remains significant and measurable adverse trends are identified despite efficiency measures
rule: If energy consumption or emissions show an adverse performance trend, strengthen energy-efficiency and demand-management measures

corrective_action: Expand solar and hybrid renewable-energy systems where technically feasible
evidence_basis: Operators have renewable-energy adoption, but scale and coverage remain limited or difficult to compare
rule: If renewable adoption is demonstrated but remains limited in scale or coverage, expand physical solar/hybrid systems where feasible

corrective_action: Complete and operationalize CPPA and related regulatory mechanisms
evidence_basis: Renewable procurement depends on unresolved external regulatory or contractual mechanisms
rule: If renewable procurement is constrained by an unresolved external regulatory mechanism, prioritize operationalization of that mechanism

corrective_action: Introduce measurable reporting requirements for tower, fibre and other infrastructure sharing
evidence_basis: Policy supports infrastructure sharing, but comparable quantitative operator-level evidence is insufficient
rule: If infrastructure sharing is supported by policy but measurable cross-operator evidence is insufficient, introduce standardized reporting requirements

corrective_action: Assign clear responsibilities and improve monitoring, coordination and accountability
evidence_basis: Inconsistent monitoring, reporting and coordination indicate organizational implementation limitations
rule: If implementation weaknesses are linked to unclear responsibilities, monitoring or coordination, assign responsibilities and strengthen accountability

corrective_action: Introduce quantitative targets, timelines and verification mechanisms
evidence_basis: Core telecom Green ICT provisions are largely qualitative and lack common numerical targets or timelines
rule: If a policy requirement lacks measurable targets, timelines or verification mechanisms, introduce quantitative and verifiable requirements
